The K Bakery is relaunching at Palisades Village as Caruso prepares to reopen the shopping center on Aug. 15. The new location will function largely as a to-go spot with some patio seating, offering pastries, signature cakes, expanded bread, breakfast items, soups, sandwiches, and beverages. The business was shuttered after the January 2025 fires destroyed the owner's family home and both of her locations.

Piada Italian Street Food plans a new location at Suite #100 at 2700 Lakeview Parkway in Rowlett, with a construction completion date targeted for November 2026. An exact opening date has not been announced, and the brand's CEO confirmed Texas will again be a focus of its 2027 growth strategy.

Anchorhead Coffee is preparing to open its fourth Seattle cafe at 4233 SW Alaska St. in West Seattle, in a space that formerly housed a Starbucks. Juici Patties plans its first Boston-area location at 16 Taber Street, Unit 1R in Roxbury, a 968-square-foot restaurant to be operated by franchisees Patrice and Oliver Dunbar. The fast-casual Jamaican chain, founded in 1978, is making its first Massachusetts entry.

Carrot Express is opening a second Brickell location at 1057 Brickell Plaza, a 1,362-square-foot space with seating for 52 guests including an outdoor patio. The Miami-based healthy fast-casual brand currently operates more than 30 locations across South Florida and New York City.

Royale Pizza Napoletana is set to open at 1680 Meridian Avenue in Miami Beach this October, featuring a 65-seat fast-casual format focused on Tokyo-style Neapolitan pizza. The Oberlin Hotel at 501 Woodburn Road in Raleigh's Village District is under construction, with plans revealed for its sixth-floor restaurant Wren, a Southern-inspired rooftop venue with craft cocktails. The 153-room hotel is part of Hilton's Curio Collection and will begin accepting reservations in January 2027.

Corner Pantry has closed its longtime location at 801 Foreman Drive in Lafayette, where it served the community for more than five decades. The family-owned business, which traces its roots to 1966, is relocating its hot-food and catering operations to a new address.

Battleground Butcher Bar is preparing to open at 1013 Battleground Ave. in Greensboro, featuring a restaurant, butcher shop, and provisions market. Post Oak Barbecue is planning a second Denver location at 1737 E. Evans Avenue, taking over the former Sawa Mediterranean Restaurant and Buffet space near the University of Denver. Gateaux Pastries, located in Denver's Golden Triangle neighborhood, will permanently close on August 29 after decades in business. Tavola, an Italian restaurant at 1800 Post Oak Blvd in Houston's Uptown neighborhood, has closed, with The Bastion Collection announcing the closure on social media this week. The ownership group did not cite a specific reason but suggested a new concept is planned for the space.
